request: Did the Apotheke get more or less from me from one month to the next in 2025? One bar per step, please.

plan.title: Change at the pharmacy, month on month
plan.question: for each month of 2025 the difference between what was spent at the pharmacies (counterparty name containing Apotheke) in it and what was spent there the month before, signed so that a cheaper month is negative, the first month left out, one row per month, columns month as 'YYYY-MM' and change_eur

sql:
WITH months AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month, SUM(-amount) AS spent
  FROM transaction_view
  WHERE amount < 0
    AND lower(coalesce(title, counterparty, description)) LIKE '%apotheke%'
  GROUP BY month
),
steps AS (
  SELECT month, spent - LAG(spent) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS change
  FROM months
)
SELECT month, ROUND(change, 2) AS change_eur
FROM steps
WHERE change IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY month

  FROM transaction_view

plan.question: the six largest shops in the Groceries category of 2025 over both accounts, one row per shop under its enriched name, columns merchant and total_eur

sql:
SELECT coalesce(title, counterparty, description) AS merchant, ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE amount < 0
  AND category = 'Groceries'
GROUP BY merchant
ORDER BY total_eur DESC
LIMIT 6

die Spalten sind merchant und total_eur ueber das ganze Jahr 2025

the columns are merchant and total_eur, and total_eur is the value pie reads
the slices are the series, so color and key both name merchant, the column of names

request: Stelle Lebensmittel, Verkehr und Shopping pro Quartal 2025 nebeneinander.

plan.title: Drei Kategorien je Quartal
plan.question: spending on Groceries, on Transport and on Shopping per quarter of 2025 over both accounts, one row per quarter and category, columns quarter as '2025-Q1', topic and total_eur

sql:
SELECT '2025-Q' || ((CAST(strftime('%m', booked_on) AS INTEGER) + 2) / 3) AS quarter, category AS topic, ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE amount < 0
  AND category IN ('Groceries', 'Transport', 'Shopping')
GROUP BY quarter, topic
ORDER BY quarter, topic

drei Kategorien ueber vier Quartale, zwei Dimensionen, die sich kreuzen
gruppierte Balken stellen die drei je Quartal nebeneinander

die Spalten sind quarter, topic und total_eur

the columns are quarter, topic and total_eur, and total_eur holds the numbers
topic is the series, so it is the z and the color channel and it needs a legend
the names on x on a band scale, tilted and none dropped, euros on y from the bare factory

request: Show how our Amazon orders added up over 2025 - the bookings read AMZN Mktp DE.

plan.title: Amazon orders added up
plan.question: spending on the Amazon marketplace bookings (description starting with AMZN Mktp) added up over 2025 across both accounts, one row per month with the running total, columns month as 'YYYY-MM' and cumulative_eur

sql:
WITH months AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month, SUM(-amount) AS spent
  FROM transaction_view
  WHERE amount < 0
    AND lower(description) LIKE 'amzn mktp%'
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT month, ROUND(SUM(spent) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS cumulative_eur
FROM months
ORDER BY month
reasoning_plan:
the request is written in English, so language en
'added up' is a running total over the months
an area under the running line reads the pace of it
the topic is the AMZN Mktp bookings, which the enrichment titles Amazon
the columns are month and cumulative_eur over the whole of 2025

the shape is area, so areaY draws the band and lineY its edge
the columns are month and cumulative_eur, and cumulative_eur holds the numbers
months on x with monthShort, euros on y
